checkins_timestamp_by_status.name: checkins_timestamp_by_status
checkins_timestamp_by_status.value: ("checkins"."status" = 'ABSENT' AND "checkins"."checked_in_at" IS NULL) OR ("checkins"."status" IN ('PRESENT', 'LATE') AND "checkins"."checked_in_at" IS NOT NULL)

cost_items_has_aggregate.name: cost_items_has_aggregate
cost_items_has_aggregate.value: "cost_items"."request_id" IS NOT NULL OR "cost_items"."session_id" IS NOT NULL

invitations_valid_expiry.name: invitations_valid_expiry
invitations_valid_expiry.value: ("invitations"."sent_at" IS NULL AND "invitations"."expires_at" IS NULL) OR ("invitations"."sent_at" IS NOT NULL AND "invitations"."expires_at" > "invitations"."sent_at")

invitations_valid_response_time.name: invitations_valid_response_time
invitations_valid_response_time.value: "invitations"."responded_at" IS NULL OR ("invitations"."sent_at" IS NOT NULL AND "invitations"."responded_at" >= "invitations"."sent_at")

notification_outbox_read_after_sent.name: notification_outbox_read_after_sent
notification_outbox_read_after_sent.value: "notification_outbox"."read_at" IS NULL OR ("notification_outbox"."sent_at" IS NOT NULL AND "notification_outbox"."read_at" >= "notification_outbox"."sent_at")

ops_work_logs_has_aggregate.name: ops_work_logs_has_aggregate
ops_work_logs_has_aggregate.value: "ops_work_logs"."request_id" IS NOT NULL OR "ops_work_logs"."session_id" IS NOT NULL

session_members_role_slot_by_type.name: session_members_role_slot_by_type
session_members_role_slot_by_type.value: ("session_members"."member_type" = 'HOST' AND "session_members"."role_slot_id" IS NULL) OR ("session_members"."member_type" = 'PARTICIPANT' AND "session_members"."role_slot_id" IS NOT NULL)
